method.paid_review_calls: Only step events explicitly tagged stage=review, matched uniquely to calls.jsonl by task_id, response content, and cost_units; require attempted=true and positive cost.
method.actions: Parse review response exactly as frozen parse_action does. Invalid or truncated JSON is invalid, even when its text starts with a python action prefix.
method.source_changes: A malformed JSON response receives a parse-error observation before any action branch can execute. Thus these two actual review calls made zero source changes; all review_kept flags are false.
method.cost: cost_units = prompt_tokens + 10 * completion_tokens; output-equivalent budget cost = cost_units / 10.
method.causal_limit: No between-run or control difference is attributed to review. No first-pass program reconstruction or separate first-pass scoring was performed.
